## Dataset-wide timestamp / leakage audit

| issue | extent | rule |
|---|---|---|
| customer_information has several dated snapshots | 2,263 customers with >1 row | as-of join (latest timestamp ≤ t) |
| first profile snapshot later than first transaction | 11.6% of customers | no profile before its first snapshot → missing |
| lastQuestionnaireDate > snapshot timestamp | 38.5% of rows | not point-in-time; use only if ≤ t |
| lastQuestionnaireDate = 2000-01-01 placeholder | 7,275 rows | missing |
| riskLevel predicted | 22.4% of rows | keep predicted flag |
| investmentCapacity predicted | 23.0% of rows | keep predicted flag |
| limit_prices.profitability / priceMaxDate / maxDate | whole-period values | never use |
| close_prices on or after t | daily to 2022-11-29 | features only from prices strictly before t |
| asset_information is one snapshot; row timestamp is not the attribute date | GRS298343005 has timestamp 2018-01-02 but name 'HELLENiQ ENERGY HOLDINGS S.A.', in force on ATHEX only from 2022-10-04 | treat names as possibly post-t; anonymised-name ablation; sector/category assumed slow-changing |
| reconstructed buys (transactionID < 0) | 38,019 rows, 35,620 on 2018-01-02 | history only, never labels |
| same transactionID for two customers (joint accounts) | 52,308 rows | one purchase may label two users |
